description: App commands of an actor-bound (hub) document are admitted in EVERY window kind of the verified app, never only the lease's window: note opens `note-composite` + `note-navigator`, and the navigator's commands (and the shell's `noteShellCommand` while it is focused) were refused as `command owner mismatch` (ticket 26/09/23 C10, S15 finding b). A window-addressed action names its window kind and base instance; a command addressed by id is issued in the view state's active window, or the lease window when the view names none. `admitted` is the window whose painted revision the command is judged against; `refused` is the worker's exact error.
